name: Sex Advice Succubus
source:
SEX ADVICE SUCCUBUS is a cozy mature chat simulator! You play as Qmin, a succubus who works for a company that provides advice to paying clients, with the goal of improving their sex life.

*GhostlyChloe is planning a visit with her online girlfriend soon, but she's worried she won't be able to show her affection physically (being a ghost and all). it's up to Qmin to give the right responses and find a solution together :)
*MajikoFan is an incubus who's anxious about having sex for the first time... what can Qmin do for someone who'd rather not have sex at all?

[Edited from [url=https://nomnomnami.itch.io/sex-advice-succubus]itch.io[/url]]

《Sex Advice Succubus》是一款温馨的成人聊天模拟游戏！你将扮演丘敏，一位在咨询公司工作的魅魔，为付费客户提供建议，帮助他们改善性生活。

—GhostlyChloe打算近期去见网恋女友，却担心自己无法通过身体接触表达爱意，毕竟，她是个幽灵。丘敏需要作出恰当的回应，与她一起寻找解决办法。:)
—MajikoFan是一位男魅魔，为即将到来的第一次性爱感到焦虑……面对一个宁愿完全不发生性关系的人，丘敏又能做些什么？
